emma_sales: Prospect EvergreenBank asking for BYO-KMS (HSM) POC. Theywill place HSM behind their outbound proxy. Need: exact egress rules, pen-test window, and concise POC quote.

jordy_eng: Accepts sidecar or managed connector in their VPC. Require outbound 443 to KMS FQDN and mTLS. If proxy terminates TLS we need TCP passthrough or the client cert won't reach their gateway.

sam_ops: Network: allow outbound 443 to provided CIDR/FQDN. Intercepting proxies add latency (measured +35ms median). For p95 <100ms recommend Dedicated routing or colocated HSM gateway. Pen-test: infra can support week of 2026-09-07 with 72h scope notice.

anya_sec: Security Qs to request: HSM vendor/model, FIPS attestation, whether keys ever leave HSM plaintext, rotation policy and operator SOPs, and SOC2 Type II. Note: Redwood never persists plaintext key material.

emma_sales: They estimate peak 60 unwraps/sec, avg 6k/day, 90d logs. Can we ballpark POC pricing?

pricing-bot: POC ballpark: integration fee usually waived for pilot; ops/routing add-on ~$1,200/mo + $0.0025 per unwrap; Dedicated routing reserved capacity extra. Finalize after unwrap profile confirmed.

emma_sales: Action items: 1) @anya_sec send Q list to EvergreenBank today, 2) @jordy_eng prepare sidecar runbook + small harness, 3) @sam_ops prepare pen-test preflight and IP list. infra-bot: BYO-KMS runbook: https://redwood.internal/byo-kms-guidelines

emma_sales: I'll send the questionnaire in 30m unless objections. :thumbsup:
